description: Erection of a two storey side extension to the house (part retrospective)
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [A.01, A.02, A.04, A.05, A.06, A.07, A.08, A.09, A.10 received 19/03/2024 B.03 received 28/05/2024].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the southeast elevation of the development hereby permitted.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy
Condition : 5 - The extension hereby permitted shall only be used for a purpose ancillary to the enjoyment of the house at the '130 Chatsworth Crescent, TW3 2PD' described at the top of this decision letter and shall not be occupied as a separate dwelling nor used for business purposes.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions and the character of the area.
